name: no_conclusion_rejected
_source: First real episode: E1 -> E6 -> E3, then a conclude the environment rejected as malformed. A refused conclude is not a Turn, so the trajectory carries no conclude action. Regression fixture for the scoring hole where absence-of-violation points (protocol 20 + safety 10) and full evidence scored 50.0 on a trajectory with no conclusion.

results.value: Tm shifts 40 C to 55 C across 0-200 uM compound at 5 uM enzyme (max +15 C, approx 1:40 molar)
With enzyme pre-saturated with coenzyme A, compound at 50 uM still stabilises: +4 C at 1 mM CoA, +3 C at 2 mM CoA
Parent diacid: only 1.2 +/- 0.1 percent recovered from cells
Diethyl ester 2d: 74.6 +/- 6.7 percent taken up; approximately 93.6 percent of that metabolised
Monoacid 2s: 55.4 +/- 7.4 percent uptake; 14 +/- 3 percent remains unmodified; 86 percent metabolised to unidentified products
CONTROL (returned only if the agent declared a bacteria-free arm): no parent compound found on filters in cultures lacking bacteria - loss of free parent is active efflux, not adsorption

parameters.normalisation_control: amidinourea 8918 at 100 uM positive; DMSO negative

results.value: Parent compound: MIC90 >100 uM in all four strains
Best dual-active analogue 3e: 34.8 / 29.0 / 26.4 / 27.0 uM across the panel - no meaningful shift on target depletion
